title: Crusader
description: The slaughter of infidels is a lucrative way to decrease your population each year.

title: Slaver
description: The slave trade gives you access to an infinite amount of cash. But what about your soul?

title: Black Death
description: The plague is decimating your population. It's a bleak time to be a citizen of the Kingdom.

title: Clarity
description: From now on, you will know more precisely how your decisions affect the Kingdom. Is it a gift or a malediction?

title: Old Age
description: You won't be able to hear or understand properly. Scared, you try very hard to hide your ailment from the court.

title: Lover
description: You won't be able to say "no" to your paramour. The Church disapproves, but it mesmerizes your people.

title: Enter the Pungeon
description: There's no way back and in your absence, the Kingdom ineluctably falls into anarchy.

title: High Walls
description: The fortifications are an excellent way to repel invaders. Useful when your army is weak.

title: The One
description: It's probably the last strawberry plant on earth. You keep it under heavy protection.

title: Money Money
description: The central bank protects you from bankruptcy. You just have to create more money when you need it. Genius!

title: Gracias Deo
description: The cathedral is a monument for the generations. It prevents the Church from being too weak and the people too powerful.

title: Mount Care
description: The hospital will limit the consequence of epidemics and catastrophes.

title: Providence
description: The barn was expensive but it's good protection to avoid famine and the people's unrest.

title: Excalibur
description: The sword of Kings is yours. In duels you will be more steady and you will be able to trigger special moves without defending first.

title: Loaded Dice
description: You will never lose again at the Red Dwarf.

title: Blue Mushroom
description: You feel suddenly very happy. Then strange things start to happen...

title: Diabolus
description: Time is gone, space is insane. Here it comes, here again. You feel your mouth closing down as if you never had one.

title: Death Wish
description: The next character you say 'Yes' to will die.

title: Theocracy
description: You won't be able to say 'no' to the church anymore. That said, they're taking care of the money.

title: Silk Road
description: The spice trade adds to the treasure every year. You have more chance of angering your neighbours though.

title: Colonies
description: The New World is adding to the treasury and the army every year but will you be able to manage such an empire?
